decision.observation: 14 mph, gear 1, all dots pale. The car is mid-junction, passing between the O Petrol banner on the left and bales marking the right shoulder; the road ahead runs up-frame, veering slightly left then right past a white fence and red barn on the right verge. A left crossroad arm with bales lies behind-left.
decision.hypothesis: The bales funnel the driving line straight up-frame here, and the car is already aligned with it, so plain throttle should carry it through the junction without a costly steer at 14 mph.
decision.memory: Junction crossing: bales flank both sides but leave a clear forward corridor, and the Petrol banners line the exit rather than blocking it. The barn with white fence sits up-right of the junction exit.
